create_BlenderDataset_for_split: create a BlenderDataset instance with a config and train or test split for NeRF training
create_DenseBlenderDataset_with_val_set: create a DenseBlenderDataset instance with a custom validation set for dense view synthesis
create_BlenderLightfieldDataset: create a BlenderLightfieldDataset instance to load lightfield data from a single transforms.json file
get_coords_rays_from_pose: get ray origins and directions for a given camera pose index using get_coords
get_intrinsics_camera_matrix: get the 3x3 camera intrinsics matrix K from a BlenderDataset or DenseBlenderDataset instance
